_comment: #594 — documented SAFE drifts between the native prover and the wallet's
@miden-sdk/miden-sdk. Two things are compared, both by
scripts/check-native-prover-pin.mjs:
1. the prover's miden-client pin
(packages/native-prover/android/rust-bridge/Cargo.toml) vs the miden-client
version behind the SDK; and
2. the transaction-kernel crates — miden-protocol, miden-tx, miden-core-lib,
miden-assembly, miden-core, miden-mast-package, miden-prover — as RESOLVED
in packages/native-prover/android/rust-bridge/Cargo.lock vs the web-sdk
tag's Cargo.lock. `miden-client = "=x.y.z"` does not pin its transitive
deps, so a matching client version is NOT evidence the procedure roots
agree.
A drift is safe ONLY when no transaction-kernel crate meaningfully moved. A
miden-client(-web/-store)-only bump keeps the same procedure set, so the pinned
prover still produces matching MAST procedure roots. Verify by diffing the two
web-sdk tags' Cargo.lock, and — for a kernel-crate drift — by diffing the two
crate sources themselves.
Prefer bumping the pin / regenerating the prover lockfile AND rebuilding the
committed prover binaries. Add an exemption only when the rebuild is deferred
and the drift is verified safe by the argument above; remove the entry once the
rebuild lands.
Each entry is keyed on (pin, sdkVersion), so it auto-expires on ANY
@miden-sdk/miden-sdk bump. sdkMidenClient is the client version that
sdkVersion's Cargo.lock is expected to resolve; a mismatch fails as stale.
`kernelDrift` must enumerate EXACTLY the kernel crates that differ, with both
versions — an unlisted crate or a changed version pair still fails.

exemptions.reason: web-sdk 0.15.9 bumped miden-client 0.15.4->0.15.5 (and miden-client-web/-sqlite-store/-idxdb-store) only; every transaction-kernel crate (miden-protocol/tx/core-lib/assembly/core/mast-package/prover) is unchanged, so the =0.15.4 prover produces the same procedure set as SDK 0.15.9. Verified by diffing the web-sdk 0.15.8/0.15.9 Cargo.lock in #594.

#798 moved the SDK stack to 0.16.0-rc.5, whose miden-client is 0.16.0-rc.3, while the native prover still pins =0.16.0-rc.2. The checker reports NO transaction-kernel drift for this pair: miden-protocol, miden-tx, miden-core-lib, miden-assembly, miden-core, miden-mast-package and miden-prover all resolve to the same versions on both sides, so the procedure roots the committed prover binaries were built against are unchanged and the client version is the only thing that moved. Inherited from next rather than introduced here — the same check fails on next's own package.json and native-prover directory. Drop this entry when the prover is next rebuilt against rc.3.
